project.title: TopoFix — auditable repair solutions
project.subtitle: Safe automatic solutions, precise manual directions, revised-source recheck and verified case outcomes.
project.aim: Topo should not burden with finding but provide auditable solution which are auto fixable if not set clear directions for manual review. Support controlled manual correction, revised-source reimport, full Topo recheck and evidence-based closure.

M1.name: Auditable disposition of current cases
M1.full: WP-A: explain each engineering case, reconcile all 66 proposals and preserve source meaning. The engineer sees what the 40-action batch changed, what remains, why actions were excluded and the supported next operation. IR assesses the current preservation gap before a bounded repair.
M1.canDo: Planned engineering outcome; completion is not inferred from evidence or task counts.

M2.name: Trustworthy source and case continuity
M2.full: WP-B: admit the supported PSI116 format, preserve immutable S0/S1 identities and bind actions to the current analysis. Track the same engineering question through authorized renumbering, insertion and deletion; ambiguous correspondence stays UNVERIFIABLE.
M2.canDo: Planned engineering outcome; completion is not inferred from evidence or task counts.

M3.name: Usable automatic and manual repair cycle
M3.full: WP-C: offer auditable safe Auto fix results or precise manual-review/repair directions, then strictly reimport an actual authorized S1, rerun complete TopoFix and reconcile original, outstanding, new and regressed cases.
M3.canDo: Planned engineering outcome; completion is not inferred from evidence or task counts.

M4.name: Verified connection and repair outcomes
M4.full: WP-D: classify evidenced connections, islands, missing joints, cross-branch links and intended terminations; independently challenge before/after semantics and demonstrate an Owner-usable end-to-end repair outcome.
M4.canDo: Planned engineering outcome; completion is not inferred from evidence or task counts.

M11.name: One explanation per engineering case
M11.full: Consolidate related findings and competing actions while retaining original witnesses. Show source/owner fields, proposed correction, reasons and next step. Measure the case count; do not equate 210 findings or 66 proposals to separate manual jobs.
M11.canDo: Current source witnesses exist; engineer-facing case consolidation is not delivered.
M11.activity: Source-qualified preview evidence; no future product writer assigned

M12.name: Disposition of all 66 proposals
M12.full: Trace 40 applied and 26 excluded proposals to source and fresh analysis. Distinguish conflicts, alternatives, prerequisites, source-authority review, preservation and unknowns. ACT-000007 only aliases 1780 to 1790; residual 1790/1800/1810 coincidence and 1790/1810 zero-length connection must remain visible.
M12.canDo: Inspect the reconstructed 26-row ledger and source evidence; engineering dispositions remain unfinished.
M12.activity: Source-qualified preview evidence; no future product writer assigned

M13.name: Preservation-safe correction eligibility
M13.full: Align planner, UI eligibility and actual mutation authorization. Preserve NodeName, ComponentRefNo, restraint, rigid, weight, OD/wall and source ownership. Qualify ACT-000030 vetoes and ACT-000194 unique-reference loss; never relax checks to restore a preferred batch count.
M13.canDo: A preservation counterexample is reproduced; no qualified safety repair has been delivered.
M13.activity: Source-qualified preview evidence; no future product writer assigned

M21.name: Admitted PSI116 source at every entrance
M21.full: Admit authentic supported PSI116 before actionable rendering/planning; reject foreign wrapper, wrong namespace and foreign consumed fields at UI/parser/transaction/reimport. Qualify supported units/profile with authentic positives; local tag names alone are insufficient.
M21.canDo: Strict admission is not implemented; Python negative controls currently accept invalid profiles.

M22.name: Immutable revisions and current-only actions
M22.full: Keep original S0; record authorized changed source as S1 with parent and raw/text identities. Bind analysis/actions to source, code/rules/config and generation; reject stale selections/results. Downloaded XML does not supersede upstream CAD authority.
M22.canDo: Revision/invalidation successor design exists; the complete behavior is not demonstrated.

M23.name: Cases survive changed occurrence identities
M23.full: Persistent case history links S0 evidence and justified S1 correspondence through renumbering/insertion/deletion. Reuse exact automatic lineage where valid; support authoritative external mapping. Missing or ambiguous mapping stays UNVERIFIABLE, never silently resolved.
M23.canDo: Renumbered/inserted-node case continuity is not implemented or demonstrated.

M31.name: Auditable Auto fix result
M31.full: Show exact accepted edits, preserved evidence, exclusions and residual/new cases after complete rebuild. Offer only the validated copy. Challenge engineering meaning as well as selected-finding disappearance; a reduced-batch PASS cannot close a surviving case.
M31.canDo: Preview transactions exist; an engineering-qualified solution-level outcome is not demonstrated.

M32.name: Precise manual-review and repair directions
M32.full: Give each nonautomatic case source/owner context, conflicting fields, what to verify, required design decision/reference, authorized repair or preserve path and the post-change check. ACT-000030 must not instruct clearing NodeName/equalizing wall merely to pass.
M32.canDo: Actionable case-specific manual directions are not implemented.

M33.name: Actual S1 repair reimport and reconciliation
M33.full: Demonstrate a source-authority-approved real repair with changed identity: immutable S1, strict reimport, fresh full analysis and original/outstanding/new/regressed reconciliation. Show justified closure, preserve, reopen or unverifiable status; include ambiguity and a newly introduced defect.
M33.canDo: No authorized real changed-identity repair/reimport cycle has been demonstrated.

M41.name: Evidence-qualified connection classifications
M41.full: Distinguish actual disconnection, islands, missing joints, cross-branch links, near misses, coincident separate systems and approved ends using evidenced compatible ports/connections. Source-order strokes and XYZ proximity remain geometric evidence, not certified edges.
M41.canDo: Full engineering connection graph is not demonstrated; near-miss screening alone is insufficient.

M42.name: Independent repair and regression proof
M42.full: Test authentic/synthetic wrong cases and affected fields/connections with independent expectation provenance. Include meaningful-record loss, residual coincidence, false joins, boundary changes, stale actions and changed identity; retain exact candidate, commands, outputs and limits.
M42.canDo: Independent before/after product qualification has not been performed.

M43.name: Owner-usable end-to-end repair trial
M43.full: Owner tries source-linked diagnosis through auditable Auto fix or precise manual directions to S1 recheck. Demonstrate automatic, controlled manual and intentional-preserve/unverifiable cases, retained evidence and new/regressed-case visibility before product acceptance/integration.
M43.canDo: The complete usable repair cycle remains unfinished; protected PR #346 remains Draft/HOLD.
